name: Nanami Hinata
source:
The daughter of Naba Sake Brewery, a long-established shop in town. She's the beloved poster girl of the shopping district, known for her adorable efforts working at the storefront.

While she has a bright and cheerful personality, she's also quite shy. She's a genuinely sweet girl who blushes bright red and beams with happiness when praised by others, including the protagonist.

She hits it off with the protagonist, who has just moved in, and they begin interacting. Each time they meet, she blushes and fidgets nervously, her earnestness making her utterly endearing.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
